author: Corridor Crew
description:
Season 3 of House of the Dragon is now streaming on HBO Max, and the dragon-riding shots have taken a serious step up in quality from the previous season. 

The VFX work was handled by a team of studios including WETA FX, Rodeo FX, and Digital Domain, all coordinated by Production VFX Supervisor Dadi Einarsson.

Did you notice this change in quality when you watch it?
title: House of the Dragons Made Riding Dragons BELIEVABLE!
